newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST, according to analysts.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Boxed beef values higher but slow fed cattle trade seen.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Rise in index should offset any pressure from steady to higher corn call.
HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. High pork cutout values and steady hog calls, but large premium will cut gains.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Higher cash product, light hog slaughter pace and technically strong.
